summary: Verified Vercel-like npm production build fix and ran UI regression smoke. Reproduced Vercel build by copying frontend sources (src, public, plugins, package.json, craco.config.js, jsconfig.json, postcss.config.js, tailwind.config.js, components.json) to /app/tmp_buildcheck WITHOUT yarn.lock/node_modules, then ran `npm install --legacy-peer-deps` (1491 packages, exit 0) and `CI=true NODE_ENV=production npm run build` -> EXIT 0, 'Compiled successfully.' (main.e8389bea.js 209.39 kB gz). Confirmed root node_modules/ajv is 8.17.1 (due to the new 'overrides' entry) and ajv-keywords is 5.1.0, so the previous 'Cannot find module ajv/dist/compile/codegen' error is resolved. Also ran local yarn build (`cd /app/frontend && CI=true npx craco build`) -> EXIT 0, 'Compiled successfully.'. package.json still has react 19.0.0 and react-dom 19.0.0; only ajv 8.17.1 + ajv-keywords 5.1.0 devDependencies and top-level `overrides: { 'ajv-keywords': { 'ajv': '8.17.1' } }` were added vs previous iteration (all other dependency versions and resolutions are unchanged). Frontend smoke on preview URL: all 10 sidebar nav items (home, marketplace, market-prices, my-produce, buyer-requests, storage, transport, orders, messages, profile) navigate successfully with 0 console errors; add-produce-button opens the in-app dialog (role='dialog', not window.prompt); apply-filters-button applies filters and shows 'Filters applied' toast; Market Prices renders 2 recharts SVG surfaces; Messages page loads; Orders page shows advance-order buttons (Mark delivered / Dispatch). grep for window.prompt / window.alert / window.confirm across /app/frontend/src returned zero matches. Build regression fix is confirmed working; no UI regressions observed.
critical_code_review_comments: package.json now carries BOTH yarn `resolutions` and npm `overrides` for ajv-keywords; this dual pinning is intentional (yarn locally, npm on Vercel) and should be documented so future upgrades of ajv-keywords don't drop only one side.
npm audit still reports 33 vulnerabilities (12 low, 6 moderate, 15 high) inherited from react-scripts 5.0.1 transitive deps; not a build blocker but worth tracking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build fix verified: npm install + npm run build both succeed in a clean scratch dir with no yarn.lock. React is still 19.0.0. If ajv-keywords is bumped later, keep the `overrides.ajv-keywords.ajv` entry in sync with the required ajv major.
rca of the issue: Root cause: react-scripts 5.0.1 -> terser-webpack-plugin -> schema-utils -> ajv-keywords@5 REQUIRES ajv@^8, but the CRA dependency tree also declared ajv@^6 elsewhere; under npm's hoisting (Vercel), the older ajv@6 was hoisted to root node_modules/ajv and ajv-keywords@5 resolved that instead of an 8.x, so `require('ajv/dist/compile/codegen')` (an ajv-8-only path) failed at webpack config load and craco build exited 1. Yarn's `resolutions` had fixed this locally but npm ignores `resolutions`. Fix: add devDependencies ajv 8.17.1 + ajv-keywords 5.1.0 and a top-level npm `overrides` entry pinning ajv-keywords' nested ajv to 8.17.1. Verified: fresh npm install now places ajv@8.17.1 at node_modules/ajv root and craco build exits 0 with 'Compiled successfully'.
